earliest_cause_rule:
walk the target's demonstrations chronologically, skipping registered legal-bad / relation-swap probe
demonstrations; the FIRST demonstration that did not end COMMITTED-and-behaviourally-exact is the divergence point, and within it the layers are
evaluated in the frozen precedence  teacher -> grounder -> controller -> evidence -> procedure  (spec §13). If no demonstration diverged, the
learn-level / budget / provider outcome decides. A provider failure is the cause only if nothing diverged earlier (spec §12 example).
mapping_notes: aborted demonstration reasons: NO_STEPS / RESTARTED_BY_TEACHER / TEACHER_GAVE_NO_REMAINING_STEPS -> TEACHER_INITIAL_FORMAT_ERROR; EXAMPLE_INCOMPLETE -> TEACHER_INITIAL_MISSING_CONTENT; MISSING_SLOT -> GROUNDER_INITIAL_OP_ERROR; INCOMPLETE / PREMATURE_TERMINATION -> CONTROLLER_PROTOCOL_VIOLATION

first recovery event of the divergent demonstration: structured illegal-plan classes -> GROUNDER_INITIAL_* (relation / sequence / op / argument); execution failure -> GROUNDER_INITIAL_ARGUMENT_ERROR; a NEEDED reference clarification -> RECOVERY_CLARIFICATION_BUDGET (or TEACHER_RECOVERY_FORMAT_ERROR if no REFERENT answer was parseable); obscured-slot restoration failure -> TEACHER_RECOVERY_MISSING_CONTENT (hosted) / GROUNDER_RECOVERY_SEMANTIC_ERROR (scripted/oracle); any other clarification of a faithful line -> GROUNDER_FALSE_CLARIFICATION (or TEACHER_RECOVERY_FORMAT_ERROR if hosted restatements had no STEP / CANCEL_SLOT line)

hosted lessons: judge label of the INITIAL lesson (unfaithful -> TEACHER_INITIAL_SEMANTIC_ERROR / MISSING_CONTENT); hosted recovery: judge label of the FINAL lesson (faithful initial + unfaithful final -> TEACHER_RECOVERY_SEMANTIC_ERROR)

no divergent demonstration: PROVIDER_* > VERIFIER_CRASH > EVIDENCE_NONVACUITY_FAILURE > PROCEDURE_ABSTRACTION_ERROR (ACTIVE but wrong) > VERIFIER_FALSE_REJECT > EVIDENCE_CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED > EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT_VARIATION > RECOVERY_TEACHER_TURN_BUDGET > RECOVERY_DEMONSTRATION_BUDGET > OTHER_PREDECLARED
wrong_action_cause: committed non-exact non-probe demonstration: hosted initial lesson unfaithful -> TEACHER_INITIAL_SEMANTIC_ERROR; recovery happened -> TEACHER_RECOVERY_SEMANTIC_ERROR (hosted recovery, final lesson unfaithful) else GROUNDER_RECOVERY_SEMANTIC_ERROR; otherwise GROUNDER_INITIAL_* by the frozen diff order relation > scope > op/sequence > argument > reference
